name: Spider-Man

moves.name: Web Line
moves.description: Yanks a weapon from a hand or pulls a foe off balance.

moves.name: Web Net
moves.description: Pins a foe to a wall or floor for a round.

moves.name: Web Shield
moves.description: Thick web barrier that absorbs one ranged hit.

moves.name: Swing Kick
moves.description: Closes distance on a web line and lands a two-footed kick.

moves.name: Flurry
moves.description: Rapid strikes too fast to follow.

moves.name: Haymaker
moves.description: Full-strength punch he only throws when it is personal.

moves.name: Leap Dodge
moves.description: Spider-sense counter: evades the next attack and repositions.

moves.name: Web Zip
moves.description: Instant reposition to any surface in range.

moves.name: Improvised Weapon
moves.description: Lamppost, car door, or manhole cover, swung hard.

moves.name: Rescue
moves.description: Spends the round pulling a civilian clear; raises morale.

leitmotif: Bouncy, syncopated lead over a swinging bassline; drops to a lonely minor melody on rooftops.
